description.en: Create, start, pause, resize and delete your cmux Cloud machines, and connect to them from cmux. Take and restore snapshots, forward a machine's ports to this Mac, and see your plan and usage. Your sign-in stays with cmux; this app never sees it.
description.ja: cmux Cloud のマシンを作成、起動、一時停止、サイズ変更、削除し、cmux から接続できます。スナップショットの作成と復元、マシンのポートのこの Mac への転送、プランと使用量の確認もできます。サインイン情報は cmux が保持し、このアプリが見ることはありません。

tagline.en: Start, pause and connect to your Cloud machines
tagline.ja: Cloud のマシンを起動、一時停止して、接続します

scopes.op:cmux.credential.relay: Send each Cloud request to cmux, which adds your sign-in and calls the cmux Cloud API. The server never receives the sign-in token.
scopes.op:cmux.host.link.get: Ask cmux which link program, network hub and folders to use for the private link to your Cloud machines, and get told when they change.
scopes.op:cmux.terminal.connector.open: Open the terminal link to a Cloud machine after you ask to connect to it. Each link needs your action.

scopes.cloud:read: See your Cloud machines and their status, your snapshots, and your plan and usage.
scopes.cloud:write: Create, start, pause, resize and delete your Cloud machines and snapshots, and forward their ports to this Mac, when you or an agent you allowed asks. Deleting always needs your OK.
scopes.cloud:execute: Upgrade an older Cloud machine by installing the current cmux on it. Only you can start an upgrade.
scopes.fs:write: Create and change files on your Cloud machines. Deleting a file, or copying files between a machine and this Mac, always needs your OK.

optionalScopes.terminal:backend: Open terminals on your Cloud machines.
